findings.label: Missing JSON-LD structured data
findings.detail: head() contains only meta tags; the scripts block with Article + BreadcrumbList schema is entirely absent. Add the scripts key with the JSON-LD object as specified in the plan's Step 2 route export.

findings.label: CSS variables use oklch() instead of spec hex values
findings.detail: --im-green, --im-leaf, --im-orange, --im-bg, and --im-charcoal are defined in oklch() notation. The spec mandates #2F4A2B, #7AB82A, #F58220, #FAFAF5, #1F2937. oklch(0.70 0.17 42) renders as approximately #D6782A — a visibly different orange. Replace with exact hex values and re-verify WCAG AA contrast for --im-orange on white.

findings.label: Section 2 heading wrong
findings.detail: <h2> reads 'Irish Sea Moss' rather than the spec-required 'What is Irish Sea Moss'. Change it to match.

findings.label: DisclaimerBox missing marketing disclaimer paragraph
findings.detail:
The second

('This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease…') is entirely absent. Add it as specified in plan Step 12.

findings.label: DisclaimerBox missing <aside> landmark
findings.detail: The disclaimer is wrapped in <section> + <div> rather than <aside role='note' aria-label='Shellfish allergy warning'>. Screen reader users navigating by landmark will not find the warning. Replace the outer <section> with the correct <aside> element.

findings.label: Benefit body text has appended sentences not in spec
findings.detail: Cards 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11 append extra wellness sentences not present in the original spec copy. The spec says 'Do not rewrite, remove, or invent text.' Trim each card body to match the spec verbatim. Card 8 (Mental Health) is the most substantial drift — the body is largely rewritten.
